basics.name: Pooya Rostami Mazrae
basics.label: Software Engineering Researcher
basics.summary: PhD researcher in software engineering focused on software repository mining, empirical studies of CI/CD and DevOps workflows, and automation ecosystems.

education.summary: Thesis: "Understanding the Evolution of GitHub Actions Automation Workflows". Advisor: Prof. Tom Mens. Funded PhD position (doctoral research scholarship).

education.institution: Sharif University of Technology, Tehran, Iran
education.summary: Thesis: "Automatic Linking of Issue Reports and Commits in Software Repositories". Advisor: Dr. Abbas Heydarnoori.

education.institution: K. N. Toosi University of Technology, Tehran, Iran
education.summary: Thesis: "Deaf Disease Genes Detection Using Artificial Intelligence Tools". Advisor: Dr. Ali Ahmadi.

work.name: University of Mons (UMONS)
work.summary: Funded PhD researcher at the Software Engineering Lab (SEL).
highlights: Doctoral research on the evolution of GitHub Actions automation workflows and CI/CD ecosystems.
Large-scale software repository mining using GitHub REST and GraphQL APIs.
Mixed-method empirical studies combining quantitative analysis and qualitative coding.
Production of peer-reviewed publications, datasets, replication packages, and open-source tools.

work.name: Necko Technologies
work.summary: Engineer and data analyst working on cloud-native FinOps platforms on AWS.
highlights: Engineered a FinOps cost optimization platform based on AWS Cost and Usage Reports (CUR v2).
Designed and deployed serverless backends using AWS Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, RDS, and S3.
Developed RESTful APIs and optimized relational data models.
Led backend architecture design for cloud-native systems.

research_experience.summary: Continuation phase of PhD research focusing on dissertation finalization and defense preparation.
Visiting researcher focusing on qualitative empirical methods in software engineering under supervision of Dr. Mairieli Wessel.
Research on software repository mining and issue–commit traceability using machine learning techniques.

research_experience.institution: K. N. Toosi University of Technology
research_experience.summary: Internship focused on data engineering, ETL pipelines, and analytical dashboards.

teaching.summary: Teaching assistant for Software Evolution course delivered to computer science master students.
Teaching assistant for master-level course on data science applications in software engineering.
Teaching assistant for undergraduate database design course.

teaching.institution: K. N. Toosi University of Technology
teaching.summary: Teaching assistant for undergraduate courses in data structures and database design.
Participated as jury member for master thesis defense.
